lists.heading: SIX GODOT FAMILIES / GODOT 표시 계열 6개
SEVEN DISC RULES / DISC 선언 규칙 7개
items: DISC-001: permanently_forbidden fact is always denied
DISC-002: stage-gated fact is denied below minimum stage
DISC-003: only [actor-A] is an eligible actor
DISC-004: eligible actor must know the requested fact
DISC-005: fresh allowed disclosure adds the requested canonical fact and disclosed ID; [fact-D] additionally adds the declared relationship-memory entry; stage is preserved
DISC-006: allowed redisplay rechecks current authorization and has no canonical mutation
DISC-007: denial preserves canonical state and emits only the safe fallback template

boundary: Read-only declarations and latest public disclosure event are separate. Missing/unreported evidence is never pass. Full canonical state is unavailable from this projection. / 읽기 전용 선언과 최신 공개 이벤트는 별개이다. 누락·미보고 근거는 통과가 아니다. 전체 정규 상태는 이 투영에서 확인할 수 없다.
